build_sparse_attention_qkvpacked: build a python module that applies scaled dot product attention to a qkv-packed SparseTensor with shape [N, *, 3, H, C]
build_sparse_attention_qkv: build a python module that applies scaled dot product attention to separate q SparseTensor and kv SparseTensor or dense tensor arguments
build_sparse_attention_qkv_separate: build a python module that applies scaled dot product attention to separate q, k, and v SparseTensors or dense tensors
test_sparse_attention_xformers: test the sparse_scaled_dot_product_attention function using xformers backend with block diagonal mask for variable sequence lengths
test_sparse_attention_flash_attn: test the sparse_scaled_dot_product_attention function using flash_attn backend with variable length sequence support
